import urllib.request
import json

# Let's check NCBI Gene for IFIT1 and MS4A1
# IFIT1: Gene ID 3434
# MS4A1: Gene ID 931

def get_ncbi_gene_info(gene_symbol):
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?db=gene&term={gene_symbol}[Gene+Name]+AND+human[Organism]&retmode=json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
        gene_id = data["esearchresult"]["idlist"][0]
        
    summary_url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=gene&id={gene_id}&retmode=json"
    req2 = urllib.request.Request(summary_url, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req2) as resp2:
        sdata = json.loads(resp2.read().decode())
        return sdata["result"][gene_id]

ifit1_info = get_ncbi_gene_info("IFIT1")
ms4a1_info = get_ncbi_gene_info("MS4A1")

print("IFIT1 Name:", ifit1_info["name"], "Description:", ifit1_info["description"])
print("MS4A1 Name:", ms4a1_info["name"], "Description:", ms4a1_info["description"])

# Let's check Ensembl or NCBI for transcript lengths and protein lengths
import urllib.request
import json

def get_ensembl_transcripts(gene_symbol):
    url = f"https://rest.ensembl.org/lookup/symbol/homo_sapiens/{gene_symbol}?expand=1"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
        print(f"=== {gene_symbol} ===")
        print(f"Gene length (genomic): {data['end'] - data['start'] + 1} bp")
        for t in data.get("Transcript", []):
            t_id = t["id"]
            is_canonical = t.get("is_canonical", 0)
            biotype = t.get("biotype", "")
            length = t["end"] - t["start"] + 1
            translation = t.get("Translation", {})
            prot_len = translation.get("length", "N/A") if translation else "N/A"
            if is_canonical:
                print(f"Canonical Transcript: {t_id}, biotype: {biotype}, length (genomic span): {length}, protein length: {prot_len}")
            else:
                print(f"Transcript: {t_id}, biotype: {biotype}, length (genomic span): {length}, protein length: {prot_len}, canonical: {is_canonical}")

get_ensembl_transcripts("IFIT1")
get_ensembl_transcripts("MS4A1")

def get_transcript_details(transcript_id):
    url = f"https://rest.ensembl.org/lookup/id/{transcript_id}?expand=1"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
        exons = data.get("Exon", [])
        cdna_len = sum(e["end"] - e["start"] + 1 for e in exons)
        return cdna_len

print("IFIT1 ENST00000378004 cDNA length:", get_transcript_details("ENST00000378004"))
print("MS4A1 ENST00000305494 cDNA length:", get_transcript_details("ENST00000305494"))
